description_en: Supports structured electronic entry of supplementary exam papers across various subjects, automatically chunking questions and applying structured labeling to produce structured output for corresponding questions, stems, options, answers, and other content
description_zh: 支持各学科的教辅试卷的结构化电子录入，将试卷中的题目进行自动化切分和结构化打标，并进行对应题目、题干、选项、答案等内容的结构化输出
kebab_example: aliyun ocr-api recognize-edu-paper-cut --cut-type question --image-type 'scan：扫描图，_photo：实拍图' --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecognizeEduPaperCut

parameters.help_en:
This field and the body field are mutually exclusive. You must specify one of them, but not both or neither.  
Image URL (must not exceed 2048 bytes in length; base64 is not supported).
parameters.help_zh:
本字段和body字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
图片链接（长度不超2048字节，不支持base64）
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en:
This field and the URL field are mutually exclusive. You must specify one of them, but not both or neither.  
Binary file of the image, up to 10 MB in size.  
When invoking via HTTP, upload the binary file in the HTTP body.  
When using the software development kit (SDK), place the image in the SDK body.
parameters.help_zh:
本字段和URL字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
图片二进制文件，最大10MB。
使用HTTP方式调用，把图片二进制文件放到HTTP body中上传即可。
使用SDK的方式调用，把图片放到SDK的body中即可
parameters.name: body
